messages.en: It's cute how you answer so diligently on Fromm.

messages.ko: 무대에서 정하연 응원 엄청 열심히 해주는 것도 귀엽고
messages.en: It's cute how you cheer for Jeong Hayeon so enthusiastically when she is on stage.
It's cute how you brag about liking me.
Tell me more.
There's more.

messages.ko: 자주 못 봐서 보고 싶다고 하는 것도 귀엽고
messages.en: It's cute when you say you miss me because you don't see me often.
How can I tell you everything?
On the contrary.

messages.ko: 육각단이 좋은 이유는 100가지도 말할 수 있을 것 같아
messages.en: I think I can list 100 reasons why the Hexagons are so great.
Whenever I feel something,
I'm the type who has to say it out loud.
So...
It might be a little cheesy,
but I have to express it.
That's what makes me feel relieved.
You're totally an F, huh??
No, I really do think that way.
I'll just accept being an F.
What? I guess I'm actually really cute then.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
You're making me not want to admit it.
I like the Hexagons too, so let's fangirl together. 🤙
Huh? Not me, the Hexagons?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 하연이가 준 카톡 사진으로 바꿨더니 선배가 누구냐고 연락 왔어
messages.en: I changed my KakaoTalk profile to the picture you gave me, and my senior messaged asking who it was.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 왠지 또 다른 내가 된 기분이네
messages.en: I feel like I've become another version of myself.
That's totally Lucky Luna, isn't it??
I'm really pushing the Lucky Luna concept.
Luna is my English name...

messages.ko: 오늘 밤도 육각단이랑 토탈 럭키 루나
messages.en: Tonight too, it's Total Lucky Luna with the Hexagons.
Luna feels like a princess. Are you a princess??
I guess so.

messages.ko: 수능까지 70일 남았는데 하연이식 가정법 분석 좀 해주세요……
messages.en: There are 70 days left until the CSAT. Please give me a Hayeon-style way of looking at it...

messages.ko: 내 인생에서 70일 동안 열심히 공부할 기회가 있는 거잖아?? 토탈 럭키 루나~
messages.en: It means I have a chance to study hard for 70 days in my life, right?? Total Lucky Luna~
Apparently Luna means the goddess of the moon!
Keㅡㅡㅡ

messages.ko: 어릴 때 아무 생각 없이 내가 고른 이름인데
messages.en: I picked that name without thinking when I was little,
but it suits me perfectly.
The moon is beautiful, isn't it?
Tsuki ga kirei desu ne~~
Luna mode is different from Haseok mode.
That's right.
Haseok is more...
like a tough younger guy.
Luna is the flower-garden positivity queen.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Hayeon is the perfect hexagonal idol.

messages.ko: 육각형은 성격이 여섯 개라서 그래. 나머지 세 개도 궁금해
messages.en: Since you're a hexagon, you should have six personalities. I'm curious about the other three.
Ah, like six different personalities?
It'd be fun if you used a different personality for every stage...
Oh, that's actually a good idea.
It'd feel like stanning six different idols.
Let's come up with the other three personalities too.
How about a gangster? Oh... you already have that one.
Hey, there's no such thing.
